narrative.offerRewardText: Your offering has been accepted. Favor you have gained. Continue and you shall be allowed access to the ancient trades.
narrative.requestItemsText:
The Thorium Brotherhood sympathizes with your plight, friend. This is why Lokthos has been empowered to bargain.

Offer 1 Lava Core and you shall be granted favor amongst the Brotherhood.
